json_ld.description:
ULTRA SHARP ONE CUT BLADE: cut through pizza with ease; super sharp blade makes slicing through any pizza a breeze; pizza cutter design presses as you slice to help keep toppings together for a clean cut, unlike messy and difficult to maneuver knives
OVERSIZED HEAVY DUTY DESIGN: pizza cutter measures 3.5 by 9 inches, making it a larger, more durable option that is easy to grip; featuring a smooth rolling blade with a finger blade for added protection, the design makes slicing a cinch
COMFORTABLE AND SLIP RESISTANT GRIP: soft touch rubber handle and angled wheel provide the optimal ergonomic grip for comfortable and easy use; a built in finger guards help to provide stability and protect your hands as you slice
DURABLE STAINLESS STEEL BLADE: features durable stainless steel construction, pizza cutter blade is rust resistant and will not bend or break; dishwasher safe for an easy clean
ALL PURPOSE SLICER: you'll be surprised how versatile this pizza cutter is; perfect for more than just pizza, easily chop salads, slice through quesadillas, hand cut pasta, cut perfect brownies, slice through layered food like lasagna, and more
json_ld.name: Pizza Cutter
